data.one_liner: Detects screenshots on Android and iOS devices in real-time.
data.what_it_does: Detects when a user takes a screenshot on Android and iOS devices. It offers real-time event listening through an EventChannel, supporting both modern Android screen capture callbacks and legacy content observers.
use_when: You need to know when a user takes a screenshot of your app.
You want to handle screenshot events on both Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You need to programmatically prevent screenshots rather than just detect them.
strengths: Provides real-time event listening using streams.
Handles modern Android 14+ screen capture callbacks and older content observers.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific permissions (like READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) for older Android versions.
data.setup_notes: Add READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission in AndroidManifest.xml for Android versions below 14 if targeting older devices.
